description: Lists the tags in use on one rank tracker, plus the project's whole tag vocabulary. Use it to find tag IDs before calling update_rank_keyword_tag, and to see how a tracker with hundreds of keywords is already organised. FREE: database only. No SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent, so it is safe to call as often as needed. The two lists mean different things and are deliberately separate. `tagsInUse` is what THIS tracker's keywords actually carry, and its `keywordCount` counts TRACKED keywords carrying the tag — not the saved-keyword count the same tag carries elsewhere, which would never match the rows it filters. It is empty for a tracker that has never used a tag. `projectTags` is the project's full vocabulary including tags unused here, so a tag can be reused rather than re-coined. The vocabulary is the project's EXISTING saved-keyword tags: one namespace shared with the saved-keyword list, not a second set.

configId.description: Rank tracker config ID. Call get_rank_tracker without a trackerId to list the project's trackers and their IDs.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: list_rank_keyword_tags
